source_text:
Assistant: How are you using AI in your work?
User: I use it for first drafts of routine emails. It saves me time, but I still check every name and number.
Assistant: What would make that process easier?
User: A one-page guide from IT showing which kinds of information we can put into the tool would help.
Assistant: So you want AI to take over writing all your emails?
User: No. I want to keep reviewing them. My question is what information I can safely include.

Assistant: Tell me about a recent experience with an AI tool.
User: Yesterday it changed the column names in a spreadsheet formula. I spent an hour finding the mismatch.
Assistant: What do you think should happen next?
User: I do not have a proposed solution. I can show someone the original file and the formula it gave me.
